title: Move French sales specifics to the new Sales FR first-party app
summary: French sales-specific functionality including SIREN No. fields and localized sales reports have been extracted into a new first-party Sales FR app, decoupling these features from the FR BaseApp layer.
key_points: New Sales FR first-party app created to host SIREN No. fields and French standard sales reports (Invoice, Credit Memo, Draft Invoice)
Moved functionality includes page and table extensions, install/upgrade codeunits, and feature key management
SIREN No. fields and GetSIRENNoWithCaption method obsoleted in FR BaseApp with CLEAN28/CLEANSCHEMA28 gates
FR BaseApp code cleaned to remove inlined French sales specifics now provided by the app
New app registered in build configuration files for independent versioning and deployment
